stories.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
stories.summary: Anthropic filed publicly for an IPO on Nasdaq under ticker ANT, disclosing soaring revenues, an $80 billion cumulative loss, massive compute commitments, and a governance model designed to preserve its AI safety mission.
stories.why: Establishes public market valuation benchmarks and highlights the unprecedented burn rate required for frontier model training.

stories.title: Meta announces $95 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
stories.summary: Meta announced plans to raise up to $95 billion through common stock and convertible preferred shares to fund its aggressive AI infrastructure expansion and custom data center buildouts.
stories.why: Demonstrates the immense balance-sheet pressure on hyperscalers to fund gigawatt-scale AI computing clusters.

stories.title: Wall Street banks, Blackstone line up $63 billion to finance Broadcom AI chips for Anthropic
stories.summary: Wall Street banks and Blackstone arranged a $63 billion debt package to finance Anthropic's leasing of custom Broadcom AI processors, bypassing traditional public cloud infrastructure.
stories.why: Signals a decisive shift toward private credit and custom ASICs to finance astronomical enterprise compute demands.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra with 3x faster AI agents, 50% lower pricing
stories.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, offering three times faster agentic performance at 50% lower API pricing to counter open-weight rivals and accelerate developer adoption.
stories.why: Crucial pricing and latency breakthrough for product managers building real-time autonomous enterprise agent workflows.

stories.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 employees
stories.summary: Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to up to 60,000 employees across India, the US, UK, and Canada as it reallocates operating budgets toward accelerating AI infrastructure spending.
stories.why: Highlights organizational restructuring as tech giants trade human headcount expenses to fund surging AI capex.

stories.title: Tata Communications to invest Rs 4,350 crore to build India's AI Super Highway, connect major data centre hubs
stories.summary: Tata Communications will invest ₹4,350 crore ($450 million) to construct a 10,000 km dedicated 'AI Super Highway' fiber network connecting major data center hubs across India.
stories.why: Addresses the critical network latency and high-bandwidth interconnect bottlenecks linking India's regional AI data clusters.

stories.title: Scoop: The FTC is demanding Anthropic execs testify in expanding AI safety probe
stories.summary: The US Federal Trade Commission demanded Anthropic executives testify under oath as it expands an investigation into autonomous AI agent safety vulnerabilities and corporate oversight.
stories.why: Heightens regulatory risk for enterprise AI platforms deploying autonomous agents into live production workflows.

related.title: FTC Subpoenas OpenAI and Anthropic as AI Safety Incidents Trigger Consumer Protection Investigation

stories.title: Bedrock Robotics Raises $600 Million As Demand for Autonomous Heavy Equipment Surges
stories.summary: Bedrock Robotics raised $600 million in fresh funding as industrial demand accelerates for physical AI systems automating heavy construction and earthmoving equipment.
stories.why: Proves surging investor appetite for physical AI delivering direct labor productivity in capital-intensive industries.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip rebounds in Q2 FY27 with $1.8M profit
stories.summary: MakeMyTrip returned to profitability in Q2 FY27, revealing that its conversational AI agent Myra handled over 90,000 daily queries across multiple Indian regional languages, primarily from Tier-2/3 cities.
stories.why: Provides a proven blueprint for deploying vernacular agentic AI to drive real transactional conversions in India.

stories.title: Protectt.ai takes majority stake in Bosch-incubated AIShield to build security platform
stories.summary: Cybersecurity firm Protectt.ai acquired a majority stake in Bosch-incubated AIShield to build an enterprise platform defending against AI agent vulnerabilities and runtime threats.
stories.why: Capitalizes on surging corporate demand for specialized governance and security guardrails protecting enterprise AI systems.

stories.title: Healthtech startup BioStack raises $9.5M in seed funding round led by Peak XV, others
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based healthtech startup BioStack raised $9.5 million in seed funding led by Peak XV Partners to expand its cross-border clinical data platform for training medical AI models.
stories.why: Addresses a critical product bottleneck by aggregating compliant, multi-geography clinical datasets needed for healthcare AI.

stories.title: Meta Business Agent aims to turn WhatsApp into a 24/7 storefront for D2C brands
stories.summary: Meta unveiled Meta Business Agent at TechSparks, turning WhatsApp into an autonomous, 24/7 conversational storefront for Indian D2C brands to handle customer acquisition and sales.
stories.why: Opens conversational commerce distribution on WhatsApp, offering PMs automated full-funnel customer engagement.

stories.title: Nevis Raises $70M Series B Led by EQT Ventures to Expand AI Platform for Wealth Management
stories.summary: Nevis raised a $70 million Series B round led by EQT Ventures to scale its AI operating system that automates advisory and compliance workflows for wealth managers.
stories.why: Demonstrates verticalized AI platform traction in high-compliance, high-margin financial services.

stories.title: Elon Musk warns hundreds of AI cloud start-ups face collapse
stories.summary: Elon Musk warned that hundreds of specialized AI cloud startups face insolvency as hyperscalers corner chip supply and venture debt conditions tighten across the industry.
stories.why: Alerts product managers to vendor lock-in and solvency risks when selecting independent GPU cloud providers.

stories.title: Verizon raises 2026 forecast and signs $2bn AI deal with AWS
stories.summary: Verizon raised its fiscal outlook and inked a $2 billion AI infrastructure agreement with AWS to embed cloud AI capabilities across its telecom network and operations.
stories.why: Highlights how telecom incumbents are leveraging cloud partnerships to monetize generative AI across legacy networks.
